### Nothing Compares to the Value of Jesus
Author: Adrian Rogers (Love Worth Finding)
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-june-10-2024.html
Passage: Philippians 3:8
Points:
- Earthly wealth and worldly advantages pale in comparison to knowing Jesus.
- Believers counter the enemy's temptations by remembering the spiritual riches they have received.
- Knowing Christ transforms a person's priorities and concept of true gain.
- Christians are called to encourage one another in the shared surpassing treasure of Christ.

### The Righteousness of God by Faith
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-righteousness-of-god-by-faith
Passage: Philippians 3:7-9
Points:
- Religious heritage and moral diligence cannot establish an acceptable standing before God.
- Paul counted his former religious pedigree as loss after encountering the glory of Christ.
- True righteousness cannot be earned through the Law but comes solely through faith in Jesus.
- Believers must continually abandon self-justification and rest entirely in God's grace.
